steps.content: The fighting is escalating. The soldier in heavy armor is always at the head. You don't even know when he has reset his left arm in the middle of all this.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Power, experience, commanding of troops, willpower... This is a formidable enemy. Can't let this drag on any longer. Get out of here, you guys... Ahhh!
The formidable enemy penetrates the defense line, makes a lunge, and knocks Earl onto the ground. He hoists his ax aloft and is about to bring it down when...

Your exclamation gives the soldier pause. Earl snatches up a stone and hurls it at him. The moment it connects with his helmet, it blows up. Earl has controlled the force of the blast so that it is just enough to knock the soldier off his feet.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Get our guys back. And ${PlayerName}, get out of here, be quick!
Hella is the first to act. She takes hold of you and whisks you away, as the FAC soldiers rush to help their captain to his feet.
A chip has been blasted off his visor. He's still alive, staring at your retreating back without blinking. This time, he doesn't give chase.

steps.speaker: Options (change)
options: They might have discovered we're working together

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: ...At least that man knows it now, or he would never have let us go, given how much he wanted to save you.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: He's protecting you. He knew you had betrayed them, but he did nothing about it. Do you two know each other?
Protecting you? You thought the FAC was on the Public Security Bureau's side. The sudden knowledge that someone from the FAC is "protecting you" comes as a bit of a surprise.
You caught a glimpse of that soldier's exposed eye as you escaped; it did look familiar to you, but you can't remember when and where you saw it.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The other soldiers are not coming after us either. The FAC doesn't seem so keen on staying too far away from their stronghold.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: ...Looks like the FAC has some other task on them.
Their defense line is extremely neat, with each strategic spot stationed with several strange-looking mega-machines. Doesn't look like it's for cracking down on riots.

You check your watch, which says 10:39. Right then you're seized by a vague but sickening sensation, which seems to be a reaction to something that has appeared out of thin air somewhere in the square.
It's a sensation that is familiar and strange at the same time. That something... you feel you've met it recently, but you also feel it's slightly different from the thing you've met.
